summary: Today, a special Yoga session for the Teachers and Administrators of Pawar Public School was successfully conducted by our very own Rotary Ann Chaitali Prabhu.
description:
Today, a special Yoga session for the Teachers and Administrators of Pawar Public School was successfully conducted by our very own Rotary Ann Chaitali Prabhu.

This thoughtful initiative was planned by the Interactors for their teachers, promoting wellness, mindfulness and healthy living. Thank you, Chaitali, for sharing your knowledge and making the session so enriching.

Congratulations to the Interactors and all those involved in this wonderful project!
